summary: Exact system-role OMP task-result, IRC, background-job completion and compaction envelopes become typed transcript events with compact neutral cards. Payloads are disclosed deliberately; Context compacted opens the shared Markdown summary renderer. Human text and near-miss envelopes remain literal.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Existing loaded timeline content is projected in the client.

schema.detail: No persisted schema change. Event carries optional typed harness facts in the client view model.

compatibility.detail: q101 app stopgap only: final system-role text/plain, bounded whole-body producer grammar, no human/user reinterpretation. Retirement gate: st adapters preserve OMP customType/details as typed TimelineBlocks including Unsupported, and the four envelope projection proofs pass against those blocks. Delete q101OmpEnvelopeStopgap and its timeline hook at that cutover. The kit is presentation-only.

recovery.detail: Original payload and envelope remain in event metadata; unrecognized envelopes stay literal.
